defect_summary: The compliant form is (Member sk_water_1 water) plus (PartOf sk_water_1 sunken_cove) — the compound part-whole/bridging route to the already-named cove.
notes: Everything else conforms, including per-occurrence Skolems correctly keyed on the die-event variable, 'at the Sunken Cove' rightly LocatedIn (a listed containment preposition), and (TimeAtMost $d dawn) matching the instruction set's own before-dawn example.
